# cc-lb

> Self-hosted Anthropic-compatible reverse proxy and load balancer for pooled API-key and OAuth upstreams.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/)
- [Getting started](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/getting-started/)
- [Concepts](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/concepts/)
- [Operations](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/operations/)
- [Reference](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/reference/)
- [Plugins](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/plugins/)
- [Trust and scope](https://cc-lb.bhyoo.com/docs/trust/)

## Supported scope

The current public contract covers Anthropic API-key and Anthropic OAuth upstreams. cc-lb is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
